features.title: Build reusable local collection foundation
features.user_visible_behavior: Local collection runs store normalized, deduplicated documents and keyword weak labels in one SQLite database, with CSV and Parquet export.
verification: Run `uv run --no-cache python -m pytest`.
Run `uv run --no-cache python scripts/export_dataset.py --database <path> --output-dir <path>`.
Run `uv run --no-cache python main.py`.
evidence: Added collection models, deterministic normalization, keyword weak labels, SQLite run tracking, exact normalized-text deduplication, annotation history, and export helpers.
Added unit and integration tests for normalization, weak labels, storage lifecycle, deduplication, annotations, direct CLI execution, CSV, and Parquet export.
`uv run --no-cache python -m pytest` passed 8 tests after directing pytest temporary files to a writable project-local base directory.

Added reusable Jaccard-or-containment deduplication, which drops candidate promotions when a shorter canonical promotion is contained in a longer template with variable trailing usernames; `uv run --no-cache python -m pytest --basetemp=.pytest-containment-final` passed 18 tests.

Added aggressive shared-prefix deduplication: at least 20 matching initial canonical tokens covering at least 80% of the shorter text. The supplied Telegram template had a 64-token, 90.1% shared prefix and is now rejected; `uv run --no-cache python -m pytest --basetemp=.pytest-prefix-final` passed 20 tests.

Hardened near-duplicate canonicalization with NFKC, Unicode format-character boundary preservation, bare Telegram URL removal tolerant of invisible characters in every t.me hostname/path position, guarded empty canonical text, counted near-duplicates in collection run statistics, and evidence-gated same-promotion-URL prefix matching for short templates. URL identity preserves ports/path/query semantics, handles malformed candidates, and cleanup snapshots SQLite WAL databases through the backup API. Mathematical Bold template, invisible separators, URL-only variants, candidate-mode filtering, empty documents, short byn88-style templates, generic-URL false positives, WAL snapshots, and duplicate counters are covered by 19 focused regression tests. Full repository verification was started at 146 tests but timed out around 67% without a test failure.

Added `docs/collection/telegram-collector.md`, covering every Telegram collection option, seed registry format, dry-run, bounded and snowball examples, filtering behavior, and export command; `uv run --no-cache python -m scripts.collect_telegram --seed-file configs/telegram_seeds.json --dry-run` verified the documented command.

Telegram CLI now accepts `--max-messages-per-channel none` for full accessible history and retries a channel after waiting `FloodWaitError.seconds`; regression coverage passed and `uv run --no-cache python -m pytest --basetemp=.pytest-telegram-full-history-final` passed 22 tests.
Telegram collection now emits reusable channel progress events and CLI checkpoints through `--progress-every`; `uv run --no-cache python -m pytest --basetemp=.pytest-progress-final` passed 23 tests.

Added optional `--target-documents-per-channel N` quota. The quota counts inserted rows per channel, reads until quota or channel exhaustion, works with snowball/targeted/incremental/control modes, records config metadata, and rejects conflicts with explicit message limits. Focused collector/CLI verification passed 14 tests.
features.notes: No network collector is included. `weak_label` is a keyword-derived candidate, not a final human label.
